raw.scene_notes: Stand shows a narrowbody aircraft at the jet bridge with a pushback tug, belt loader, baggage carts, maintenance stairs, ground crew and a deliberately placed safety cone. Apron surface has stains, patches and painted markings (stand G69, 737/320 stop lines, red hatching). No loose foreign objects identified on the ground.

Narrowbody aircraft at gate with jet bridge attached; fuel truck under right wing with worker handling a wheel/hose reel near a flag; ground power cable connected to nose. Background shows runways/taxiways with frost and distant buildings. No clear loose debris identified on the apron surface; ground near nose gear is dark and shadowed, limiting detection of small objects.
